definitions.explanation: An ongoing medical condition that one has had for a long time and may continue to have.

examples.japanese: {持病|じびょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{喘息|ぜんそく}→喘息：08444_zensoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪化|あっか}した→悪化する：18844_akkasuru⟧。
{持病|じびょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{定期的|ていきてき}→定期的：06173_teikiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}っている→通う：01217_kayou⟧。
examples.english: I go to the hospital regularly because I have a chronic condition.

examples.japanese: {持病|じびょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なければ→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}り→入る：00494_hairu⟧やすい。
examples.english: It's easier to get insurance if you don't have a chronic illness.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ (to have) + {病|びょう} (illness) → illness one has = chronic condition

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {持病|じびょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ - to have a chronic condition
- {持病|じびょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抱|かか}える→抱える：02031_kakaeru⟧ - to be living with a chronic illness
- {持病|じびょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪化|あっか}する→悪化する：18844_akkasuru⟧ - for a chronic condition to worsen

COMMON CHRONIC CONDITIONS:
- ⟦{糖尿病|とうにょうびょう}→糖尿病：04414_tounyoubyou⟧ - diabetes
- ⟦{高血圧|こうけつあつ}→高血圧：04415_kouketsuatsu⟧ - high blood pressure
- ⟦{喘息|ぜんそく}→喘息：08444_zensoku⟧ - asthma
- ⟦{腰痛|ようつう}→腰痛：05020_youtsuu⟧ - chronic back pain

USAGE:
Often mentioned when filling out medical forms, insurance applications, or when explaining one's health situation.
